segment.description: East Fork Shoal Creek (GNIS 01283364, NHD reachcode 06030004000241), a small Giles County tributary joining Shoal Creek at ~35.0079,-87.0995 (HUC 06030004 Lower Elk per NHD/TDEC station metadata). TWRA's 2026 stocking schedule lists a Lawrence County trout water of this name - an identity mismatch flagged below, since the TWRA stocking sites plot on the Shoal Creek main stem in Lawrenceburg, not on the GNIS-named fork.
segment.boundaries: Catalog gives no reach limits. Record covers the GNIS/NHD-named East Fork Shoal Creek (Giles Co., HUC 06030004) and separately documents the TWRA 'East Fork Shoal Creek' fishery, whose 2026 stocking sites are 'Park' (35.2308,-87.3295) and 'Water Plant' (35.2435,-87.3464), Lawrenceburg - coordinates that fall on the Shoal Creek main stem (HUC 06030005) per NHD.

coldSource.notes: Small low-elevation stream: the TDEC station at the mouth sits at ~35.008 N on Shoal Creek Road and the upstream TDEC station at 35.0205,-87.0931; no published elevation datum found. A documented spring exists in the same HUC (USGS 'WEST FORK SHOAL CREEK SPRING NEAR MINOR HILL, TN', WQP station USGS-350223087074201, 780 ft) but it belongs to the West Fork, a different water.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. The TWRA program is a put-and-take 'Seasonal' spring schedule (five 2026 stocking weeks: 2/15, 3/8, 3/22, 5/10, 5/31), not a year-round program, and no TWRA sampling or creel document speaks to survival between stockings on this water.

wildPopulation.detail: Not on TWRA's wild trout stream list; statewide trout rules apply (7 trout/day, no length limit) with no special regulation on this water. The TDEC fish-community sampling program at these stations reports no trout records in WQP.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TDEC monitoring shows June-September water of 21.0-25.4 C (most recently 21.1-24.0 C in summer 2022) at the mouth and mid-fork stations, too warm for trout to carry through summer beyond TWRA's Feb-May put-and-take window.
